profile.headline: Platform Engineer and Solutions Architect
profile.summary: Hi! I’m Brett, a polyglot software architect and full-stack developer with a passion for acceptance testing. I have more than 18 years working in the industry. I specialize in growing development teams, cloud architecture and distributed systems, building robust testing & deployment pipelines and optimizing developer workflows.

positions.locationName: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.locationName: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia · Hybrid
positions.description:
Reviewed and consulted on technical architecture and application designs.
Rebuilt Gitlab CI/CD pipeline to use immutable artifact deployments and Gitlab releases.
Modernised their IAAC and SLDC workflows.
Added OpenTelemetry and observability tooling across the Akordi platform, integrating with AWS XRay.
Built a secure system for automated in-cluster database migrations.
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Gitlab · Solution Architecture · Engineering Support

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a comprehensive Knowledge Management & AI Governance Data Pipeline, ensuring data integrity and security.  
• Architected and implemented an AI Support Chatbot that deflected ~55% of support escalations, enhancing customer service efficiency.  
• Developed an AI Evaluation Framework to analyze user interactions, identifying key areas for improvement in AI responses.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Python (Programming Language) · LangChain · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Argo · Elixir

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant - Backend
positions.description: Managed Square Enix membership account system, and performed a monumental migration away from an expensive Kafka-based event sourcing system.
positions.insights: Skills: Elixir · Phoenix · Apache Kafka · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Kubernetes · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Gitlab

positions.title: Independent Game Developer
positions.locationName: Greater London, England, United Kingdom · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed and released "SplitFire," an engaging head-to-head mobile game for two players.  
• Established a Twitch stream and YouTube channel to showcase the game development process using the Godot engine.  
• Created a split-screen arena featuring diverse power-ups and weapons, enhancing player experience.  
• Gained valuable experience in commercial game development through this fun and creative project.
positions.insights: Skills: Godot · Phoenix · Webrtc · Terraform · DevOps · Elixir

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Led the architectural design and development of Wi5's QR-code ordering platform, transforming the hospitality ordering experience.  
• Spearheaded the integration of multiple Point-Of-Sale systems, including Lightspeed and NCR, enhancing operational efficiency.  
• Developed a modular payment processing system, successfully integrating with Sage Pay and Adyen, including support for Google Pay and Apple Pay.

positions.title: Senior Devops Engineer
positions.description: Wi5 gets customers ordering and paying on mobile in-venue, with no apps required. Piggybacking existing Wi-Fi, the Wi5 platform delivers an instantly gratifying and frictionless app-like mobile experience without the need for any native apps, other downloads or a cumbersome login process - helping businesses from quick service restaurants to stadiums and arenas decrease queues and increase sales.

positions.title: Senior Devops Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented unit and acceptance test suites for our platform API, and added them to our pull request workflow using CircleCI.
Added UI automation tests using Capybara and added to our CI/CD workflows running in AWS CodePipeline.
Managed our TeamCity CI Windows build servers, building our Unity3d builds in AWS EC2.
Maintained legacy Opscode Chef cookbooks.
Introduced Terraform to manage our infrastructure-as-code, splitting our environments into AWS sub accounts, and private and public subnets for added security.
Transitioned from an “instance-per-service” to a docker-based deployment for greater utilization and deployment speed.
Built a geo-distributed mesh of Golang multiplayer network messaging servers.
Added latency auto-detection system to choose best region for multiplayer sessions.
Oversaw our security and compliance work for SOC 2 and CRISC audits.
Introduced DevOps “war games” for exposing developers to infrastructure concepts and disaster response.
Integrated tooling into our company Slack, so that pull requests, CI/CD builds and alerts from our monitoring system were visible to the team in our Slack channels in real-time.
Added Sentry.io exception monitoring to our applications, and ELK for logging.
Added a geo-distributed monitoring system based on Sensu, and connected this to Pagerduty.
Built an “OpsCLI” command line tool for recurring DevOps tasks, and distributed it to developers.
Built an “SDKCLI” command line tool for managing our Unity3d builds, tests and project management, and distributed it to inhouse and 3rd-party developers.
Removed our complicated Unity3d build steps with single-commands from the new SDKCLI.
Set up automated shutdowns and security checks on AWS Lambda.
Set up automated deployments of our SDK documentation using S3 and a CloudFront distrubution.
Set up a secure private asset distribution service with signed URLs using CloudFront.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built journey estimation services using NodeJS and map routing technologies.
Guided the transition from physical servers to cloud-based solutions.
Setup automated build & publish pipelines for our frontend applications and backend microservices.
Designed and built partner pricing.
Built customer-facing and business-facing applications using ReactJS and Redux.
Worked closely with the CTO to deliver product roadmaps and goals for the technology team.
Optimized developer workflows by focusing on test performance and slow build times.
Rebuilt core search services using Elasticsearch.
Rebuilt the core real-time systems, migrating from NodeJS to Elixir Phoenix approach for higher performance.
Instigated collaborative programming among developers including ‘pair programming’ and ‘mob programming’ sessions.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built the profile matching system using Elasticsearch and stable marriage algorithms.

Built an automated scheduling system which sends push notifications to genders and cohorts based on demand and time scaling.

Helped build their billing systems and Stripe interface.

Built and deployed 2 POC mobile applications “Fun Button” and "DrinkUp" using ReactJS for on-demand geospatial events and parties.

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web development and user interface design.

Ruby, Rails, PHP, Javascript, Rspec, BackboneJS, jQuery, Drupal.

Drupal 6 and 7 custom theme development and module development.
Frontend web development.
Mobile applications.

Rails 2 and 3 applications.
BackboneJS.

Flash and actionscript programming.

Web application deployment.
Devops with Opscode Chef.
Linux VPS management and adimistration.

positions.title: Web Development Consultant
positions.description: Web development and design & UI expertise.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Drupal module development.
Drupal custom themes.
Graphic design.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Web Development, Drupal, Flash, Actionscript, Javascript, jQuery, CSS, Drupal theming, Drupal module development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web development focussing on Drupal, PHP, Actionscript 2 & 3, ExtJs, jQuery and Javascript.

Included a moderate amount of Flash animation & banner ad design.
Also, small amounts of graphic design.
